title: refactor(plugin-grid): move ObjectGrid's host-facing props types and FooterSummaryReport into sibling modules (slice 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi94Cr2fbhp665MVvsYFfqYFe)_

Part of #25994 (slice 2 of the move-only split; the card stays open for the later slices).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What moved

Base `71580254` (main with slice 1, #26323). This slice finishes the module-level part of `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` that no test pins. It moves two groups, verbatim, into two new sibling modules:

- `objectGridProps.ts`: `ObjectGridColumnState`, `ObjectGridFooterSummary` and `ObjectGridExternalPaginationProps`, with their docblocks. These are the host-facing props types that `ObjectGridComponentProps` builds on.
- `objectGridFooterSummaryReport.tsx`: `FooterSummaryReport`, the renderless component that reports the grid's column summaries to a host.

144 lines move, and `ObjectGrid.tsx` goes from 6781 to 6637 lines. `FooterSummaryReport` gains the `export` keyword in its new module. `ObjectGrid.tsx` imports the moved names back and re-exports the three types, so every name it exported is still importable from the same path. The package entry (`index.tsx`) is untouched. No identifier is renamed, no logic or DOM changes, and no new name is exported from `ObjectGrid.tsx`.

Move-only proof: the multiset of non-blank lines of the base `ObjectGrid.tsx` equals the new `ObjectGrid.tsx` plus the two modules (each module's header comment dropped, the added `export` keyword normalised). Nothing is missing. The only other lines are the import lines and the one type re-export line.

## Changeset correction from slice 1

Slice 1's changeset (`.changeset/25994-objectgrid-helpers-split.md`, still unreleased) listed "the record-source ladder" among the moved query helpers, but `getDataConfig` stayed in `ObjectGrid.tsx`: exported, it would have become a shared reader for `check:doc-example-readers`. The correction lives as one sentence in this slice's own changeset (`.changeset/25994-objectgrid-props-split.md`). Slice 1's note is untouched, so `check-empty-changeset` has nothing to refuse.

## What module-level code stays in `ObjectGrid.tsx`, and why

- `parseSchemaSort` and its sibling `toOrderByClause`: `gridArrayArmOrderby-8973.test.tsx` asserts `export function parseSchemaSort` is in the file, and `toOrderByClause`'s docblock is written about the call sites beside it.
- `ObjectGridComponentProps`: `bulkExecutorDataSourceFace-9722.test.ts` asserts `export interface ObjectGridComponentProps` is in the file. Its docblock sits above `ObjectGridRowOperations`, so `ObjectGridRowOperations` stays too: moving it would re-attach that docblock to a different declaration.
- `getDataConfig`, which stays file-local (see above).
- The schema-slot types (`RemoveIndexSignature` and the rest): `cellClassNameCensusProse-6921.test.ts` reads the census prose in their docblock from `ObjectGrid.tsx`.
- The relational-copy-set docblock, which is prose about code in this file.
- The group-heading date region (`TemporalGroupFace`, `temporalGroupHeading`): #26341 (#25884) is editing it.

So after this slice, the remaining work on the card is the component body.

## Test edits

None.

## Verification

Run on head `f1e4df4c` (tree identical to the commits the tests ran on; only the commit messages were reworded before the push):

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ --maxWorkers=2`, the whole package suite, under the verification lock: 251 of 251 files and 2247 of 2247 tests passed after the move. The before reading is the same suite on slice 1's head (`8fe81ee9`, whose tree is `main` `71580254` for this package): 251 of 251 files, 2247 of 2247 tests, locally and in CI.
- The 52 test files outside plugin-grid that read sources (the same list slice 1 used): 52 of 52 files, 2257 of 2257 tests passed.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` exit 0.
- eslint on the three files: 0 errors.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:doc-example-readers` exit 0.
- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`: the manifest is byte-identical (sha256 `1f6e1ccb…`). Only `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/plugin-grid.json` is re-recorded. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 41 derived gates; `--ran` reconciles 41 of 41 (0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). All 41 exit 0; `check-empty-changeset` was re-run on `ba1445b9`.

## Landing

Seat 2's #26307 and #26341 land first on the plugin-grid line, so this stays a draft. Expect a merge of `main` and a re-record of `plugin-grid.json` before it lands.

Changesets: `.changeset/25994-objectgrid-props-split.md` (patch, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`).
